name: johnhringiv.com
description: This project is a web application built using PHP and JavaScript. It is configured to run with Nginx and PHP-FPM inside a Docker container.

scripts.build:dev: mkdir -p www/generated && cp src/css/main.css www/generated/bundle.css && cp src/css/cissp-charts.css www/generated/cissp-charts.css && esbuild src/js/main.js --bundle --outfile=www/generated/bundle.js
scripts.build:prod: mkdir -p www/generated && lightningcss --minify --bundle -o www/generated/bundle.css src/css/main.css && lightningcss --minify --bundle -o www/generated/cissp-charts.css src/css/cissp-charts.css && esbuild src/js/main.js --bundle --minify --outfile=www/generated/bundle.js && esbuild src/js/cissp-charts.js --bundle --minify --outfile=www/generated/cissp-charts.js
scripts.build:charts: mkdir -p www/generated && esbuild src/js/cissp-charts.js --bundle --minify --outfile=www/generated/cissp-charts.js && lightningcss --minify --bundle -o www/generated/cissp-charts.css src/css/cissp-charts.css
scripts.build:charts:dev: mkdir -p www/generated && esbuild src/js/cissp-charts.js --bundle --sourcemap --outfile=www/generated/cissp-charts.js && cp src/css/cissp-charts.css www/generated/cissp-charts.css
scripts.generate: npm run generate:shiki && npm run generate:mermaid
